elstyleSaver.innerContent:
Must allow a minimum of 5 semester days (Fall & Winter) to respond and more than 50% of the total ballot responses are required for it to be a valid ballot.
Voting Options are:
  • Aye (Yes)
  • Nay (No)
  • Abstain (non-vote that counts as a response in determining if it's a valid ballot)
  • No Response (ballot was sent but ignored, this does not count as a response in determining if it's a valid ballot)
If the originator is submitting a curriculum proposal for a course(s) to be added to the Michigan Transfer Agreement, the following is the required balloting process:
Michigan Transfer Agreement
Balloting - All faculty college-wide

Please provide the results of the College-wide balloting - attach printed ballots to original
